name: prompt-630
image_purpose: two-person mirror selfie and plush-hat styling reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic oval-mirror selfie of two approved adults in a colorful toy store.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult man on the left in a gray casual top and approved adult woman on the right with long straight hair, a modest hot-pink top, pearl necklace, rings, and playful wink. Keep both identities separate and do not imitate public figures.
prompt.composition_elements: Both wear large generic plush animal hats: orange fox ears and gray rabbit ears. Include yellow phone, oval mirror, toy shelves, chandelier, soft mall lighting, and realistic plush fibers. Avoid named character franchises, logos, or copyrighted character likenesses.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft commercial indoor mall lighting, vibrant saturated colors, playful toy-store mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone-style mirror selfie, portrait 4:5, sharp faces and plush texture, accurate mirror reflection, natural skin tones.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Two approved adults pose in an oval mirror inside a colorful toy store, wearing generic orange fox-ear and gray rabbit-ear plush hats. The man wears a gray top; the woman wears a modest hot-pink top with pearl necklace and rings while winking. Include a yellow phone, toy shelves, chandelier, vibrant mall lighting, and realistic plush texture. No franchise character names, logos, or public figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, franchise character likeness, branded logo, distorted mirror, face mixing, extra fingers, warped hat, watermark, public figure likeness.
